name: Dell G16 AWCC-Oma
author: rikalonikola
description: Alienware Command Center alternative made for the Dell G16: thermal profiles, fan boost, keyboard lighting and sensors, with the F7 light key and the G key. Checks the laptop model before it writes to any hardware. Needs the bundled awcc CLI.

barWidget.description: Dell G16 thermal profile, fan boost, keyboard lighting and temperatures.
